sdk.source: RC2 VMR F# subtree, locally built; not an official RC2 SDK

sdk_payload.runtime_qualification: The local RC2-source compiler runs on the exact .NET 11 RC1 runtime. It is a source-built compiler comparison, not a measurement of an official RC2 SDK/runtime bundle.

new.source: Self-hosted Release build of the same pinned VMR RC2/main production source as the third-wave campaign

framework.compiler_gc: Server GC and very-large-object support, matching desktop fsc configuration
framework.allocation_api: AppDomain.MonitoringTotalAllocatedMemorySize: current compiler AppDomain, all threads; ARM enabled
framework.path_support: Native longPathAware manifest; required to read the unchanged 260+ character source paths. No source/path rewriting.
